description: This file defines a custom exception class `ClientIdentifierNotFoundException` used within the Fineract project to indicate that a client identifier resource was not found. It extends a base exception class `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` and provides constructors that generate specific error messages.

classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a client identifier resource was not found, extending the platform's base resource not found exception. It provides constructors to specify error messages and optionally include a cause exception.
